using GZip
using Random
using Statistics
using LinearAlgebra

function _parse_a3m(lines, taxonomy, max_seqs=nothing)
    visited = Set()
    sequences = []
    deletions = []
    residues = []
    seq_idx = 0
    for line in lines
        line = strip(line)
        if isempty(line) || startswith(line, "#")
            continue
        end
        if startswith(line, ">")
            header = split(line)[1]
            if !isnothing(taxonomy) && startswith(header, ">UniRef100")
                uniref_id = split(header, "_")[2]
                taxonomy_id = get(taxonomy, uniref_id, nothing)
                if isnothing(taxonomy_id)
                    taxonomy_id = -1
                end
            else
                taxonomy_id = -1
            end
            continue
        end
        str_seq = replace(uppercase(line), "-" => "")
        if !(str_seq in visited)
            push!(visited, str_seq)
        else
            continue
        end
        residue = []
        deletion = []
        count = 0
        res_idx = 0
        for c in line
            if c != '-' && islowercase(c)
                count += 1
                continue
            end
            token = const_prot_letter_to_token[c]
            token = const_mapping_boltz_token_ids_to_our_token_ids[const_token_ids[token]]
            push!(residue, token)
            if count > 0
                push!(deletion, (res_idx, count))
                count = 0
            end
            res_idx += 1
        end
        res_start = length(residues)
        res_end = res_start + length(residue)
        del_start = length(deletions)
        del_end = del_start + length(deletion)
        push!(sequences, (seq_idx, taxonomy_id, res_start, res_end, del_start, del_end))
        append!(residues, residue)
        append!(deletions, deletion)
        seq_idx += 1
        if !isnothing(max_seqs) && seq_idx >= max_seqs
            break
        end
    end
    msa = MSA(
        residues=Array{MSAResidue}(residues),
        deletions=Array{MSADeletion}(deletions),
        sequences=Array{MSASequence}(sequences)
    )
    return msa
end

function parse_a3m(path, taxonomy, max_seqs=nothing)
    if endswith(path, ".gz")
        GZip.open(string(path), "r") do f
            msa = _parse_a3m(f, taxonomy, max_seqs)
        end
    else
        open(path, "r") do f
            msa = _parse_a3m(f, taxonomy, max_seqs)
        end
    end
    return msa
end

function aggregate_fn(original_seqs, attention_mask)
    batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token = size(attention_mask)[1:3]
    if max_num_atoms_per_token != 24
        error("Only 24 atoms per token is supported")
    end
    aggregated_seqs = []
    for t in original_seqs
        push!(aggregated_seqs, rearrange(t, "b n a ... -> b (n a) ...", a=24))
    end
    function reverse_fn(aggregated_seqs)
        original_seqs = []
        for t in aggregated_seqs
            push!(original_seqs, rearrange(t, "b (n a) ... -> b n a ...", a=24))
        end
        return original_seqs
    end
    return aggregated_seqs, reverse_fn
end

function aggregate_fn_advanced(original_seqs, attention_mask)
    batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token = size(attention_mask)[1:3]
    if max_num_atoms_per_token != 24
        error("Only 24 atoms per token is supported")
    end
    attention_mask = Bool.(attention_mask)
    num_atoms = sum(attention_mask, dims=(2, 3))
    if any(num_atoms .== 0)
        error("Some sequences have zero atoms. Please remove them before aggregation.")
    end
    max_atoms = maximum(num_atoms)
    range_tensor = 0:(max_atoms-1)
    range_tensor = repeat(reshape(range_tensor, 1, :), batch_size, 1)
    output_attention_mask = range_tensor .< reshape(num_atoms, :, 1)
    aggregated_seqs = []
    for t in original_seqs
        push!(aggregated_seqs, zeros(eltype(t), batch_size, max_atoms, size(t)[4:end]...))
    end
    for i in 1:length(original_seqs)
        aggregated_seqs[i][output_attention_mask] = original_seqs[i][attention_mask]
    end
    function reverse_fn(aggregated_seqs)
        original_seqs = []
        for aggregated_seq in aggregated_seqs
            new_batch_size = size(aggregated_seq, 1)
            if new_batch_size != batch_size
                original_seq = zeros(eltype(aggregated_seq), new_batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token, size(aggregated_seq)[3:end]...)
                new_attention_mask = repeat(attention_mask, outer=[div(new_batch_size, batch_size), 1, 1])
                new_output_attention_mask = repeat(output_attention_mask, outer=[div(new_batch_size, batch_size), 1])
                original_seq[new_attention_mask] = aggregated_seq[new_output_attention_mask]
            else
                original_seq = zeros(eltype(aggregated_seq), batch_size, num_tokens, max_num_atoms_per_token, size(aggregated_seq)[3:end]...)
                original_seq[attention_mask] = aggregated_seq[output_attention_mask]
            end
            push!(original_seqs, original_seq)
        end
        return original_seqs
    end
    return aggregated_seqs, reverse_fn
end

function slice_at_dim(t, dim_slice, dim)
    dim += (ndims(t) if dim < 0 else 0)
    colons = [Colon() for _ in 1:ndims(t)]
    colons[dim] = dim_slice
    return t[colons...]
end

function concat_previous_and_later_windows(t, dim_seq, dim_window)
    @assert dim_seq == dim_window - 1
    first = slice_at_dim(t, 1:8, dim=dim_seq)
    first = reshape(first, size(first)[1:dim_seq-1]..., :, size(first)[dim_window+1:end]...)
    first = reshape(first, size(first)[1:dim_seq-1]..., 1, size(first)[dim_seq:end]...)
    last = slice_at_dim(t, (size(t, dim_seq)-7):size(t, dim_seq), dim=dim_seq)
    last = reshape(last, size(last)[1:dim_seq-1]..., :, size(last)[dim_window+1:end]...)
    last = reshape(last, size(last)[1:dim_seq-1]..., 1, size(last)[dim_seq:end]...)
    t = pad_at_dim(t, (3, 4), dim=dim_seq, value=0.0)
    left = cat(
        slice_at_dim(t, 1:2:size(t, dim_seq)-7, dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 2:2:size(t, dim_seq)-6, dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 3:2:size(t, dim_seq)-5, dim=dim_seq),
        dims=dim_window
    )
    middle = cat(
        slice_at_dim(t, 4:2:size(t, dim_seq)-4, dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 5:2:size(t, dim_seq)-3, dim=dim_seq),
        dims=dim_window
    )
    right = cat(
        slice_at_dim(t, 6:2:size(t, dim_seq)-2, dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 7:2:size(t, dim_seq)-1, dim=dim_seq),
        slice_at_dim(t, 8:2:size(t, dim_seq), dim=dim_seq),
        dims=dim_window
    )
    t = cat(left, middle, right, dims=dim_window)
    t = cat(
        first, first,
        slice_at_dim(t, 3:size(t, dim_seq)-2, dim=dim_seq),
        last, last,
        dims=dim_seq
    )
    return Array(t)
end

function lens_to_mask(lens, max_len)
    device = lens.device
    if isnothing(max_len)
        max_len = maximum(lens)
    end
    arange = 0:(max_len-1)
    return reshape(arange, 1, :) .< reshape(lens, :, 1)
end

function pad_to_multiple(t, multiple, dim=-1, value=0.0)
    seq_len = size(t, dim)
    padding_needed = (multiple - (seq_len % multiple)) % multiple
    if padding_needed == 0
        return t
    end
    return pad_at_dim(t, (0, padding_needed), dim=dim, value=value)
end

function repeat_consecutive_with_lens(feats, lens)
    feats = repeat(feats, outer=[1, 24, 1])
    return feats
end

function repeat_consecutive_with_lens_advanced(feats, lens)
    device, dtype = feats.device, eltype(feats)
    batch, seq = size(feats)[1:2]
    dims = size(feats)[3:end]
    mask = lens_to_mask(lens, nothing)
    window_size = size(mask, 2)
    arange = 0:(window_size-1)
    cumsum_len = cumsum(lens, dims=2)
    offsets = vcat(zeros(eltype(cumsum_len), size(cumsum_len, 1), 1), cumsum_len[:, 1:end-1], dims=2)
    indices = reshape(arange, 1, 1, :) .+ reshape(offsets, :, :, 1)
    total_lens = sum(lens, dims=2)
    output_mask = lens_to_mask(total_lens, nothing)
    max_len = maximum(total_lens)
    output_indices = zeros(Int, batch, Int(max_len + 1))
    indices[.!mask] .= max_len
    indices = reshape(indices, batch, :)
    seq_arange = 0:(seq-1)
    seq_arange = repeat(seq_arange, outer=window_size)
    for i in 1:batch
        for j in 1:length(seq_arange)
            output_indices[i, indices[i, j]+1] = seq_arange[j]
        end
    end
    output_indices = output_indices[:, 1:end-1]
    output = zeros(eltype(feats), batch, size(output_indices, 2), dims...)
    for i in 1:batch
        for j in 1:size(output_indices, 2)
            output[i, j, :] = feats[i, output_indices[i, j]+1, :]
        end
    end
    mask_value = dtype == Bool ? false : 0
    output[.!reshape(output_mask, size(output_mask, 1), size(output_mask, 2), ones(Int, length(dims))...)] .= mask_value
    return output
end

function pad_and_window(t, window_size)
    t = pad_to_multiple(t, window_size, dim=2)
    t = reshape(t, size(t, 1), :, window_size, size(t)[3:end]...)
    return t
end

function mean_pool_with_lens(feats, feats_mask, lens, eps=1e-6)
    seq_len = size(feats, 2)
    if seq_len % 24 != 0
        error("Sequence length must be divisible by 24")
    end
    feats = reshape(feats, size(feats, 1), :, 24, size(feats)[3:end]...)
    feats_mask = reshape(feats_mask, size(feats_mask, 1), :, 24, size(feats_mask)[3:end]...)
    feats = sum(feats .* reshape(feats_mask, size(feats_mask)[1:3]..., 1, size(feats_mask)[4:end]...), dims=3) ./ (sum(feats_mask, dims=3, keepdims=true) .+ eps)
    return feats
end

function pad_at_dim(t, pad, dim=-1, value=0.0)
    dims_from_right = (dim < 0) ? (-dim - 1) : (ndims(t) - dim - 1)
    zeros_pad = Tuple(vcat([0, 0 for _ in 1:dims_from_right]..., pad...))
    return pad(t, zeros_pad, value=value)
end

mutable struct BackboneTrunk
    globals
    config
    recycling_iters
    input_embedder
    recycling_embedder
    template_embedder
    msa_embedder
    msa_stack
    pairformer
    aux_heads
end

function BackboneTrunk(config)
    globals = config.globals
    config_backbone = config.backbone
    recycling_iters = config_backbone.recycling_iters
    input_embedder = InputEmbedder(config_backbone["input_embedder"]...)
    recycling_embedder = RecyclingEmbedder(config_backbone["recycling_embedder"]...)
    template_embedder = config_backbone.template_embedder.enabled ? TemplateEmbedder(config_backbone["template_embedder"]...) : nothing
    msa_embedder = MSAEmbedder(config_backbone["msa"]["msa_embedder"]...)
    msa_stack = MSAModuleStack(config_backbone["msa"]["msa_stack"]...)
    pairformer = PairformerStack(config_backbone["pairformer_stack"]...)
    aux_heads = AuxiliaryHeads(config_backbone["heads"])
    return BackboneTrunk(globals, config_backbone, recycling_iters, input_embedder, recycling_embedder, template_embedder, msa_embedder, msa_stack, pairformer, aux_heads)
end

function iteration(model::BackboneTrunk, feats, inits, prevs)
    outputs = Dict()
    dtype = Float32
    for k in keys(feats)
        if eltype(feats[k]) == Float32
            feats[k] = convert(Array{dtype}, feats[k])
        end
    end
    batch_dims = size(feats["aatype"])[1:end-2]
    no_token = size(feats["aatype"])[end-1]
    inplace_safe = false
    single_mask = feats["seq_mask"]
    pair_mask = single_mask[:, :, :] .* reshape(single_mask, size(single_mask)[1:end-1]..., 1, size(single_mask)[end])
    msa_mask = feats["msa_mask"]
    s_init, z_init, s_inputs = inits
    s_prev, z_prev = [pop!(prevs) for _ in 1:2] |> reverse
    if isnothing(s_prev) || isnothing(z_prev)
        s_prev = zeros(dtype, batch_dims..., no_token, model.config.input_embedder.c_s)
        z_prev = zeros(dtype, batch_dims..., no_token, no_token, model.config.input_embedder.c_z)
    end
    s_prev_emb, z_prev_emb = model.recycling_embedder(s_prev, z_prev, inplace_safe=inplace_safe)
    s = add(s_init, s_prev_emb, inplace=false)
    z = add(z_init, z_prev_emb, inplace=false)
    if model.config.template_embedder.enabled
        template_embeds = model.template_embedder(feats, z, pair_mask, chunk_size=model.globals.chunk_size, use_deepspeed_evo_attention=model.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention, inplace_safe=inplace_safe, _mask_trans=model.config._mask_trans)
        z = add(z, template_embeds, inplace_safe)
    end
    m, msa_mask = model.msa_embedder(feats, s_inputs, msa_mask, inplace_safe=inplace_safe)
    m, z = model.msa_stack(m, z, msa_mask=msa_mask, pair_mask=pair_mask, chunk_size=model.globals.chunk_size, use_deepspeed_evo_attention=model.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention, inplace_safe=inplace_safe, _mask_trans=model.config._mask_trans)
    s, z = model.pairformer(s, z, single_mask=single_mask, pair_mask=pair_mask, chunk_size=model.globals.chunk_size, use_deepspeed_evo_attention=model.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention, inplace_safe=inplace_safe, _mask_trans=model.config._mask_trans)
    outputs["z"] = z
    outputs["s"] = s
    outputs["s_inputs"] = s_inputs
    s_prev = outputs["s"]
    z_prev = outputs["z"]
    return outputs, s_prev, z_prev
end

function forward(model::BackboneTrunk, feats)
    inplace_safe = false
    s_prev, z_prev = nothing, nothing
    prevs = [s_prev, z_prev]
    is_grad_enabled = true
    num_iters = model.recycling_iters + 1
    s_init, z_init, s_inputs = model.input_embedder(feats, chunk_size=model.globals.chunk_size, use_deepspeed_evo_attention=model.globals.use_deepspeed_evo_attention, inplace_safe=inplace_safe)
    inits = [s_init, z_init, s_inputs]
    for cycle_no in 1:num_iters
        is_final_iter = cycle_no == num_iters
        outputs, s_prev, z_prev = iteration(model, feats, inits, prevs)
        if !is_final_iter
            prevs = [s_prev, z_prev]
        else
            break
        end
    end
    merge!(outputs, model.aux_heads(outputs))
    return outputs
end

struct TokenData
    token_idx::Int
    atom_idx::Int
    atom_num::Int
    res_idx::Int
    res_type::Int
    sym_id::Int
    asym_id::Int
    entity_id::Int
    mol_type::Int
    center_idx::Int
    disto_idx::Int
    center_coords::Array{Float64}
    disto_coords::Array{Float64}
    resolved_mask::Bool
    disto_mask::Bool
    cyclic_period::Int
end

struct BoltzTokenizer
end

function tokenize(tokenizer::BoltzTokenizer, data)
    struct_data = data.structure
    token_data = []
    token_idx = 0
    atom_to_token = Dict()
    chains = struct_data.chains[struct_data.mask]
    mol_types = [c.mol_type for c in chains]
    for (chain, mol_type) in zip(chains, mol_types)
        res_start = chain.res_idx
        res_end = chain.res_idx + chain.res_num
        for res in struct_data.residues[res_start:res_end]
            atom_start = res.atom_idx
            atom_end = res.atom_idx + res.atom_num
            if res.is_standard
                center = struct_data.atoms[res.atom_center]
                disto = struct_data.atoms[res.atom_disto]
                is_present = res.is_present & center.is_present
                is_disto_present = res.is_present & disto.is_present
                c_coords = center.coords
                d_coords = disto.coords
                token = TokenData(token_idx, res.atom_idx, res.atom_num, res.res_idx, res.res_type, chain.sym_id, chain.asym_id, chain.entity_id, chain.mol_type, res.atom_center, res.atom_disto, c_coords, d_coords, is_present, is_disto_present, chain.cyclic_period)
                push!(token_data, token)
                for atom_idx in atom_start:atom_end-1
                    atom_to_token[atom_idx] = token_idx
                end
                token_idx += 1
            else
                unk_token = const_unk_token["PROTEIN"]
                unk_id = const_mapping_boltz_token_ids_to_our_token_ids[const_token_ids[unk_token]]
                res_name = res.name
                if const_chain_types[mol_type] != "NONPOLYMER" && haskey(const_CCD_NAME_TO_ONE_LETTER, res_name)
                    res_type = res.res_type
                else
                    res_type = unk_id
                end
                atom_data = struct_data.atoms[atom_start:atom_end]
                atom_coords = [a.coords for a in atom_data]
                for (i, atom) in enumerate(atom_data)
                    is_present = res.is_present & atom.is_present
                    index = atom_start + i - 1
                    token = TokenData(token_idx, index, 1, res.res_idx, res_type, chain.sym_id, chain.asym_id, chain.entity_id, chain.mol_type, index, index, atom_coords[i], atom_coords[i], is_present, is_present, chain.cyclic_period)
                    push!(token_data, token)
                    atom_to_token[index] = token_idx
                    token_idx += 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
    token_bonds = []
    for bond in struct_data.bonds
        if !haskey(atom_to_token, bond.atom_1) || !haskey(atom_to_token, bond.atom_2)
            continue
        end
        token_bond = (atom_to_token[bond.atom_1], atom_to_token[bond.atom_2])
        push!(token_bonds, token_bond)
    end
    for conn in struct_data.connections
        if !haskey(atom_to_token, conn.atom_1) || !haskey(atom_to_token, conn.atom_2)
            continue
        end
        token_bond = (atom_to_token[conn.atom_1], atom_to_token[conn.atom_2])
        push!(token_bonds, token_bond)
    end
    token_data = Array{Token}([t for t in token_data])
    token_bonds = Array{TokenBond}(token_bonds)
    tokenized = Tokenized(token_data, token_bonds, data.structure, data.msa, data.residue_constraints)
    return tokenized
end

function _fetch_dims(tree)
    shapes = []
    tree_type = typeof(tree)
    if tree_type <: Dict
        for v in values(tree)
            append!(shapes, _fetch_dims(v))
        end
    elseif tree_type <: Union{Array, Tuple}
        for t in tree
            append!(shapes, _fetch_dims(t))
        end
    elseif tree_type <: Array
        push!(shapes, size(tree))
    else
        error("Not supported")
    end
    return shapes
end

function _flat_idx_to_idx(flat_idx, dims)
    idx = []
    for d in reverse(dims)
        push!(idx, flat_idx % d)
        flat_idx = div(flat_idx, d)
    end
    return Tuple(reverse(idx))
end

function _get_minimal_slice_set(start, end_idx, dims, start_edges=nothing, end_edges=nothing)
    function reduce_edge_list(l)
        tally = 1
        for i in 1:length(l)
            reversed_idx = length(l) - i + 1
            l[reversed_idx] *= tally
            tally = l[reversed_idx]
        end
    end
    if isnothing(start_edges)
        start_edges = [s == 0 for s in start]
        reduce_edge_list(start_edges)
    end
    if isnothing(end_edges)
        end_edges = [e == (d - 1) for (e, d) in zip(end_idx, dims)]
        reduce_edge_list(end_edges)
    end
    if length(start) == 0
        return [()]
    elseif length(start) == 1
        return [(start[1]:end_idx[1],)]
    end
    slices = []
    path = []
    for (s, e) in zip(start, end_idx)
        if s == e
            push!(path, s:s)
        else
            break
        end
    end
    path = Tuple(path)
    divergence_idx = length(path) + 1
    if divergence_idx > length(dims)
        return [Tuple(path)]
    end
    function upper()
        sdi = start[divergence_idx]
        return [
            Tuple(vcat(path, (sdi:sdi,), s)) for s in
            _get_minimal_slice_set(
                start[divergence_idx+1:end],
                [d - 1 for d in dims[divergence_idx+1:end]],
                dims[divergence_idx+1:end],
                start_edges=start_edges[divergence_idx+1:end],
                end_edges=[1 for _ in end_edges[divergence_idx+1:end]]
            )
        ]
    end
    function lower()
        edi = end_idx[divergence_idx]
        return [
            Tuple(vcat(path, (edi:edi,), s)) for s in
            _get_minimal_slice_set(
                [0 for _ in start[divergence_idx+1:end]],
                end_idx[divergence_idx+1:end],
                dims[divergence_idx+1:end],
                start_edges=[1 for _ in start_edges[divergence_idx+1:end]],
                end_edges=end_edges[divergence_idx+1:end]
            )
        ]
    end
    if start_edges[divergence_idx] && end_edges[divergence_idx]
        push!(slices, Tuple(vcat(path, (start[divergence_idx]:end_idx[divergence_idx],))))
    elseif start_edges[divergence_idx]
        push!(slices, Tuple(vcat(path, (start[divergence_idx]:end_idx[divergence_idx]-1,))))
        append!(slices, lower())
    elseif end_edges[divergence_idx]
        append!(slices, upper())
        push!(slices, Tuple(vcat(path, (start[divergence_idx]+1:end_idx[divergence_idx],))))
    else
        append!(slices, upper())
        middle_ground = end_idx[divergence_idx] - start[divergence_idx]
        if middle_ground > 1
            push!(slices, Tuple(vcat(path, (start[divergence_idx]+1:end_idx[divergence_idx]-1,))))
        end
        append!(slices, lower())
    end
    return [Tuple(s) for s in slices]
end

function _chunk_slice(t, flat_start, flat_end, no_batch_dims)
    batch_dims = size(t)[1:no_batch_dims]
    start_idx = collect(_flat_idx_to_idx(flat_start, batch_dims))
    end_idx = collect(_flat_idx_to_idx(flat_end - 1, batch_dims))
    slices = _get_minimal_slice_set(start_idx, end_idx, batch_dims)
    sliced_tensors = [t[s...] for s in slices]
    return vcat([reshape(s, :, size(t)[no_batch_dims+1:end]...) for s in sliced_tensors]...)
end

function chunk_layer(layer, inputs, chunk_size, no_batch_dims, low_mem=false, _out=nothing, _add_into_out=false)
    if !(length(inputs) > 0)
        error("Must provide at least one input")
    end
    initial_dims = [size(v)[1:no_batch_dims] for v in values(inputs)]
    orig_batch_dims = Tuple([maximum([s[i] for s in initial_dims]) for i in 1:no_batch_dims])
    function _prep_inputs(t)
        if !low_mem
            if sum(size(t)[1:no_batch_dims]) != no_batch_dims
                t = repeat(t, outer=vcat(orig_batch_dims, ones(Int, ndims(t) - no_batch_dims)))
            end
            t = reshape(t, :, size(t)[no_batch_dims+1:end]...)
        else
            t = repeat(t, outer=vcat(orig_batch_dims, ones(Int, ndims(t) - no_batch_dims)))
        end
        return t
    end
    prepped_inputs = Dict(k => _prep_inputs(v) for (k, v) in inputs)
    prepped_outputs = nothing
    if !isnothing(_out)
        reshape_fn = t -> reshape(t, :, size(t)[no_batch_dims+1:end]...)
        prepped_outputs = Dict(k => reshape_fn(v) for (k, v) in _out)
    end
    flat_batch_dim = prod(orig_batch_dims)
    no_chunks = div(flat_batch_dim, chunk_size) + (flat_batch_dim % chunk_size != 0 ? 1 : 0)
    i = 1
    out = prepped_outputs
    for _ in 1:no_chunks
        if !low_mem
            select_chunk = t -> size(t, 1) != 1 ? t[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, end), :] : t
        else
            select_chunk = t -> _chunk_slice(t, i-1, min(flat_batch_dim, i+chunk_size-1), length(orig_batch_dims))
        end
        chunks = Dict(k => select_chunk(v) for (k, v) in prepped_inputs)
        output_chunk = layer(; chunks...)
        if isnothing(out)
            allocate = t -> zeros(eltype(t), flat_batch_dim, size(t)[2:end]...)
            out = Dict(k => allocate(v) for (k, v) in output_chunk)
        end
        out_type = typeof(output_chunk)
        if out_type <: Dict
            function assign(d1, d2)
                for (k, v) in d1
                    if typeof(v) <: Dict
                        assign(v, d2[k])
                    else
                        if _add_into_out
                            v[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, end), :] .+= d2[k]
                        else
                            v[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, end), :] = d2[k]
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            assign(out, output_chunk)
        elseif out_type <: Tuple
            for (x1, x2) in zip(out, output_chunk)
                if _add_into_out
                    x1[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, end), :] .+= x2
                else
                    x1[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, end), :] = x2
                end
            end
        elseif out_type <: Array
            if _add_into_out
                out[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, end), :] .+= output_chunk
            else
                out[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, end), :] = output_chunk
            end
        else
            error("Not supported")
        end
        i += chunk_size
    end
    reshape_fn = t -> reshape(t, orig_batch_dims..., size(t)[2:end]...)
    out = Dict(k => reshape_fn(v) for (k, v) in out)
    return out
end

mutable struct ChunkSizeTuner
    max_chunk_size::Int
    cached_chunk_size::Union{Nothing,Int}
    cached_arg_data::Union{Nothing,Any}
end

function ChunkSizeTuner(max_chunk_size=512)
    return ChunkSizeTuner(max_chunk_size, nothing, nothing)
end

function _determine_favorable_chunk_size(tuner::ChunkSizeTuner, fn, args, min_chunk_size)
    @info "Tuning chunk size..."
    if min_chunk_size >= tuner.max_chunk_size
        return min_chunk_size
    end
    candidates = [2^l for l in 0:Int(floor(log2(tuner.max_chunk_size)))]
    candidates = [c for c in candidates if c > min_chunk_size]
    candidates = vcat([min_chunk_size], candidates)
    candidates[end] += 4
    function test_chunk_size(chunk_size)
        try
            fn(args..., chunk_size=chunk_size)
            return true
        catch
            return false
        end
    end
    min_viable_chunk_size_index = 1
    i = length(candidates)
    while i > min_viable_chunk_size_index
        viable = test_chunk_size(candidates[i])
        if !viable
            i = div(min_viable_chunk_size_index + i, 2)
        else
            min_viable_chunk_size_index = i
            i = div(i + length(candidates), 2)
        end
    end
    return candidates[min_viable_chunk_size_index]
end

function _compare_arg_caches(tuner::ChunkSizeTuner, ac1, ac2)
    consistent = true
    for (a1, a2) in zip(ac1, ac2)
        @assert typeof(ac1) == typeof(ac2)
        if typeof(ac1) <: Union{Array,Tuple}
            consistent &= _compare_arg_caches(tuner, a1, a2)
        elseif typeof(ac1) <: Dict
            a1_items = [v for (_, v) in sort(collect(ac1), by=x->x[1])]
            a2_items = [v for (_, v) in sort(collect(ac2), by=x->x[1])]
            consistent &= _compare_arg_caches(tuner, a1_items, a2_items)
        else
            consistent &= a1 == a2
        end
    end
    return consistent
end

function tune_chunk_size(tuner::ChunkSizeTuner, representative_fn, args, min_chunk_size)
    consistent = true
    remove_tensors = a -> typeof(a) <: Array ? size(a) : a
    arg_data = [remove_tensors(a) for a in args]
    if !isnothing(tuner.cached_arg_data)
        @assert length(tuner.cached_arg_data) == length(arg_data)
        consistent = _compare_arg_caches(tuner, tuner.cached_arg_data, arg_data)
    else
        consistent = false
    end
    if !consistent
        tuner.cached_chunk_size = _determine_favorable_chunk_size(tuner, representative_fn, args, min_chunk_size)
        tuner.cached_arg_data = arg_data
    end
    return tuner.cached_chunk_size
end

function get_chain_cluster(chain, record)
    return chain.cluster_id
end

function get_interface_cluster(interface, record)
    chain1 = record.chains[interface.chain_1]
    chain2 = record.chains[interface.chain_2]
    cluster_1 = string(chain1.cluster_id)
    cluster_2 = string(chain2.cluster_id)
    cluster_id = (cluster_1, cluster_2)
    cluster_id = Tuple(sort([cluster_id...]))
    return cluster_id
end

function get_chain_weight(chain, record, clusters, beta_chain, alpha_prot, alpha_nucl, alpha_ligand)
    prot_id = const_chain_type_ids["PROTEIN"]
    rna_id = const_chain_type_ids["RNA"]
    dna_id = const_chain_type_ids["DNA"]
    ligand_id = const_chain_type_ids["NONPOLYMER"]
    weight = beta_chain / clusters[chain.cluster_id]
    if chain.mol_type == prot_id
        weight *= alpha_prot
    elseif chain.mol_type in [rna_id, dna_id]
        weight *= alpha_nucl
    elseif chain.mol_type == ligand_id
        weight *= alpha_ligand
    end
    return weight
end

function get_interface_weight(interface, record, clusters, beta_interface, alpha_prot, alpha_nucl, alpha_ligand)
    prot_id = const_chain_type_ids["PROTEIN"]
    rna_id = const_chain_type_ids["RNA"]
    dna_id = const_chain_type_ids["DNA"]
    ligand_id = const_chain_type_ids["NONPOLYMER"]
    chain1 = record.chains[interface.chain_1]
    chain2 = record.chains[interface.chain_2]
    n_prot = chain1.mol_type == prot_id ? 1 : 0
    n_nuc = chain1.mol_type in [rna_id, dna_id] ? 1 : 0
    n_ligand = chain1.mol_type == ligand_id ? 1 : 0
    n_prot += chain2.mol_type == prot_id ? 1 : 0
    n_nuc += chain2.mol_type in [rna_id, dna_id] ? 1 : 0
    n_ligand += chain2.mol_type == ligand_id ? 1 : 0
    weight = beta_interface / clusters[get_interface_cluster(interface, record)]
    weight *= alpha_prot * n_prot + alpha_nucl * n_nuc + alpha_ligand * n_ligand
    return weight
end

struct ClusterSampler
    alpha_prot::Float64
    alpha_nucl::Float64
    alpha_ligand::Float64
    beta_chain::Float64
    beta_interface::Float64
end

function ClusterSampler(; alpha_prot=3.0, alpha_nucl=3.0, alpha_ligand=1.0, beta_chain=0.5, beta_interface=1.0)
    return ClusterSampler(alpha_prot, alpha_nucl, alpha_ligand, beta_chain, beta_interface)
end

function sample(sampler::ClusterSampler, records, random)
    chain_clusters = Dict()
    for record in records
        for chain in record.chains
            if !chain.valid
                continue
            end
            cluster_id = get_chain_cluster(chain, record)
            if !haskey(chain_clusters, cluster_id)
                chain_clusters[cluster_id] = 0
            end
            chain_clusters[cluster_id] += 1
        end
    end
    interface_clusters = Dict()
    for record in records
        for interface in record.interfaces
            if !interface.valid
                continue
            end
            cluster_id = get_interface_cluster(interface, record)
            if !haskey(interface_clusters, cluster_id)
                interface_clusters[cluster_id] = 0
            end
            interface_clusters[cluster_id] += 1
        end
    end
    items = []
    weights = []
    for record in records
        for (chain_id, chain) in enumerate(record.chains)
            if !chain.valid
                continue
            end
            weight = get_chain_weight(chain, record, chain_clusters, sampler.beta_chain, sampler.alpha_prot, sampler.alpha_nucl, sampler.alpha_ligand)
            push!(items, (record, 0, chain_id))
            push!(weights, weight)
        end
        for (int_id, interface) in enumerate(record.interfaces)
            if !interface.valid
                continue
            end
            weight = get_interface_weight(interface, record, interface_clusters, sampler.beta_interface, sampler.alpha_prot, sampler.alpha_nucl, sampler.alpha_ligand)
            push!(items, (record, 1, int_id))
            push!(weights, weight)
        end
    end
    weights = weights ./ sum(weights)
    while true
        item_idx = rand(random, Categorical(weights))
        record, kind, index = items[item_idx]
        if kind == 0
            produce(Sample(record=record, chain_id=index))
        else
            produce(Sample(record=record, interface_id=index))
        end
    end
end

const _IPTM_WEIGHT = 0.8
const _FRACTION_DISORDERED_WEIGHT = 0.5
const _CLASH_PENALIZATION_WEIGHT = 100.0

function calculate_chain_based_ptm(p_pae, input_features)
    diffusion_batch_size = size(p_pae, 1)
    single_mask = input_features["seq_mask"]
    frame_mask = input_features["frame_mask"]
    asym_id = input_features["asym_id"]
    asym_id_to_asym_mask = Dict(aid => asym_id .== aid for aid in unique(asym_id))
    if haskey(asym_id_to_asym_mask, 0)
        delete!(asym_id_to_asym_mask, 0)
    end
    N_chain = length(asym_id_to_asym_mask)
    chain_ptm = zeros(diffusion_batch_size, N_chain)
    chain_pair_iptm = zeros(diffusion_batch_size, N_chain, N_chain)
    chain_iptm = zeros(diffusion_batch_size, N_chain)
    for index in 1:diffusion_batch_size
        for (aid, asym_mask) in asym_id_to_asym_mask
            chain_ptm[index, aid] = compute_tm(p_pae[index:index, :, :, :], residue_weights=frame_mask .* single_mask .* asym_mask)
        end
        for aid_i in 1:N_chain
            for aid_j in 1:N_chain
                if aid_i == aid_j
                    chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_ptm[index, aid_i]
                    continue
                end
                if aid_i > aid_j
                    chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_j, aid_i]
                end
                pair_asym_mask = asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_i] .+ asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_j]
                chain_pair_iptm[index, aid_i, aid_j] = compute_tm(p_pae[index:index, :, :, :], residue_weights=frame_mask .* single_mask .* pair_asym_mask, interface=true, asym_id=asym_id)
            end
        end
        for (aid, asym_mask) in asym_id_to_asym_mask
            pairs = [(i, j) for i in 1:N_chain for j in 1:N_chain if (i == aid || j == aid) && (i != j)]
            vals = [chain_pair_iptm[index, i, j] for (i, j) in pairs]
            if length(vals) > 0
                chain_iptm[index, aid] = mean(vals)
            end
        end
    end
    return chain_iptm, chain_pair_iptm, chain_ptm
end

function calculate_chain_based_plddt(plddt, input_features)
    diffusion_batch_size = size(plddt, 1)
    pred_dense_atom_mask = input_features["pred_dense_atom_mask"]
    single_mask = input_features["seq_mask"]
    asym_id = input_features["asym_id"]
    asym_id_to_asym_mask = Dict(aid => asym_id .== aid for aid in unique(asym_id))
    if haskey(asym_id_to_asym_mask, 0)
        delete!(asym_id_to_asym_mask, 0)
    end
    N_chain = length(asym_id_to_asym_mask)
    chain_plddt = zeros(diffusion_batch_size, N_chain)
    chain_pair_plddt = zeros(diffusion_batch_size, N_chain, N_chain)
    for index in 1:diffusion_batch_size
        for (aid, asym_mask) in asym_id_to_asym_mask
            asym_pred_dense_atom_mask = (pred_dense_atom_mask .* reshape(asym_mask, size(asym_mask)..., 1))[1, :, :]
            chain_plddt[index, aid] = mean(plddt[index, asym_pred_dense_atom_mask])
        end
        for aid_i in 1:N_chain
            for aid_j in 1:N_chain
                if aid_i == aid_j
                    chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_plddt[index, aid_i]
                    continue
                end
                if aid_i > aid_j
                    chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_i, aid_j] = chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_j, aid_i]
                end
                pair_asym_mask = asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_i] .+ asym_id_to_asym_mask[aid_j]
                pair_asym_pred_dense_atom_mask = (pred_dense_atom_mask .* reshape(pair_asym_mask, size(pair_asym_mask)..., 1))[1, :, :]
                chain_pair_plddt[index, aid_i, aid_j] = mean(plddt[index, pair_asym_pred_dense_atom_mask])
            end
        end
    end
    return chain_plddt, chain_plddt
end

function calculate_clash(coords, input_features, cutoff_radius=1.1, min_clashes_for_overlap=100, min_fraction_for_overlap=0.5)
    has_clashes = zeros(Float32, size(coords, 1))
    is_polymer = (.!input_features["is_ligand"] .& input_features["seq_mask"])
    if sum(is_polymer) == 0
        return has_clashes
    end
    pred_dense_atom_mask = input_features["pred_dense_atom_mask"]
    pred_dense_atom_mask = pred_dense_atom_mask .* reshape(is_polymer, size(is_polymer)..., 1)
    coords = coords[:, pred_dense_atom_mask[1, :], :]
    max_atoms = 24
    atom_leval_resid = repeat(reshape(input_features["residue_index"], :, 1), outer=[1, max_atoms])[pred_dense_atom_mask]
    atom_level_chainid = repeat(reshape(input_features["asym_id"], :, 1), outer=[1, max_atoms])[pred_dense_atom_mask]
    chain_ids = unique(atom_level_chainid)
    for index in 1:size(coords, 1)
        coord_kdtree = KDTree(coords[index, :, :])
        clashes_per_atom = inrange(coord_kdtree, coords[index, :, :], cutoff_radius)
        per_atom_has_clash = zeros(Int32, size(coords, 2))
        for (atom_idx, clashing_indices) in enumerate(clashes_per_atom)
            for clashing_idx in clashing_indices
                if abs(atom_leval_resid[atom_idx] - atom_leval_resid[clashing_idx]) > 1 || (atom_level_chainid[atom_idx] != atom_level_chainid[clashing_idx])
                    per_atom_has_clash[atom_idx] = 1.0
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        for chain_id in chain_ids
            mask = atom_level_chainid .== chain_id
            num_atoms = sum(mask)
            if num_atoms == 0
                continue
            end
            num_clashes = sum(per_atom_has_clash[mask])
            frac_clashes = num_clashes / num_atoms
            if (num_clashes > min_clashes_for_overlap || frac_clashes > min_fraction_for_overlap)
                has_clashes[index] = 1.0
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return has_clashes
end

function get_summary_confidence(outputs, input_features)
    x_predicted = outputs["x_predicted"]
    plddt = outputs["plddt"]
    pae = outputs["pae"]
    pde = outputs["pde"]
    ptm = outputs["ptm"]
    iptm = outputs["iptm"]
    chain_iptm, chain_pair_iptm, chain_ptm = calculate_chain_based_ptm(outputs["p_pae"], input_features)
    chain_plddt, chain_pair_plddt = calculate_chain_based_plddt(outputs["plddt"], input_features)
    has_clashes = calculate_clash(x_predicted, input_features)
    diffusion_batch_size = size(plddt, 1)
    summary_confidences_list = []
    global_plddt = [mean(plddt[i, input_features["pred_dense_atom_mask"][1, :]]) for i in 1:diffusion_batch_size]
    for index in 1:diffusion_batch_size
        if iptm[index] == 0.0
            ptm_iptm_average = ptm[index]
        else
            ptm_iptm_average = _IPTM_WEIGHT * iptm[index] + (1.0 - _IPTM_WEIGHT) * ptm[index]
        end
        fraction_disordered_ = 0.0
        ranking_score = ptm_iptm_average + _FRACTION_DISORDERED_WEIGHT * fraction_disordered_ - _CLASH_PENALIZATION_WEIGHT * has_clashes[index]
        summary_confidences = Dict(
            "chain_plddt" => chain_plddt[index, :],
            "chain_pair_plddt" => chain_pair_plddt[index, :, :],
            "chain_iptm" => sum(chain_iptm[index, :]) > 0 ? chain_iptm[index, :] : [nothing for _ in 1:length(chain_iptm[index, :])],
            "chain_pair_iptm" => chain_pair_iptm[index, :, :],
            "chain_ptm" => chain_ptm[index, :],
            "fraction_disordered" => fraction_disordered_,
            "has_clash" => has_clashes[index],
            "plddt" => global_plddt[index],
            "iptm" => iptm[index] > 0.0 ? iptm[index] : nothing,
            "ptm" => ptm[index],
            "ranking_score" => ranking_score
        )
        push!(summary_confidences_list, summary_confidences)
    end
    return summary_confidences_list
end

function get_full_confidence(outputs, input_features, structure)
    x_predicted = outputs["x_predicted"]
    plddt = outputs["plddt"]
    pae = outputs["pae"]
    single_mask = input_features["seq_mask"][1, :]
    full_pae = [pae[i, single_mask, single_mask] for i in 1:size(pae, 1)]
    asym_id_to_chain_id = Dict()
    structure = remove_invalid_chains(structure)
    chains = structure.chains
    for chain_idx in 1:length(chains)
        chain = chains[chain_idx]
        chain_id, mol_type, entity_id, sym_id, asym_id, atom_idx, atom_num, res_idx, res_num, _ = chain
        asym_id_to_chain_id[asym_id+1] = chain_id
    end
    pred_dense_atom_mask = input_features["pred_dense_atom_mask"]
    max_atoms = 24
    atom_leval_resid = repeat(reshape(input_features["residue_index"], :, 1), outer=[1, max_atoms])[pred_dense_atom_mask]
    atom_level_chainid = repeat(reshape(input_features["asym_id"], :, 1), outer=[1, max_atoms])[pred_dense_atom_mask]
    atom_chain_ids = [asym_id_to_chain_id[cid] for cid in atom_level_chainid]
    atom_plddts = [plddt[i, pred_dense_atom_mask[1, :]] for i in 1:size(plddt, 1)]
    asym_ids = input_features["asym_id"][1, single_mask]
    token_chain_ids = [asym_id_to_chain_id[aid] for aid in asym_ids]
    token_res_ids = input_features["residue_index"][1, single_mask]
    full_confidences_list = []
    diffusion_batch_size = size(plddt, 1)
    for index in 1:diffusion_batch_size
        full_confidences = Dict(
            "atom_chain_ids" => atom_chain_ids,
            "atom_plddts" => atom_plddts[index],
            "pae" => full_pae[index],
            "token_chain_ids" => token_chain_ids,
            "token_res_ids" => token_res_ids
        )
        push!(full_confidences_list, full_confidences)
    end
    return full_confidences_list
end

mutable struct AF3Attention
    c_q::Int
    c_k::Int
    c_v::Int
    c_hidden::Int
    no_heads::Int
    gating::Bool
    linear_q
    linear_k
    linear_o
    linear_g
end

function AF3Attention(c_q, c_k, c_v, c_hidden, no_heads; gating=true, conditioned=false)
    linear_q = Linear(c_q, c_hidden * no_heads, bias=true)
    linear_k = Linear(c_k, c_hidden * no_heads, bias=false)
    if conditioned
        linear_o = Linear(c_hidden * no_heads, c_q, bias=false)
    else
        linear_o = Linear(c_hidden * no_heads, c_q, bias=false)
    end
    linear_g = gating ? Linear(c_q, c_hidden * no_heads, bias=false) : nothing
    return AF3Attention(c_q, c_k, c_v, c_hidden, no_heads, gating, linear_q, linear_k, linear_o, linear_g)
end

mutable struct AdaLN
    layer_norm_a
    layer_norm_s
    linear_s_gamma
    sigmoid
    linear_s_beta
end

function AdaLN(c_a, c_s)
    layer_norm_a = LayerNorm(c_a, affine=false, bias=false)
    layer_norm_s = LayerNorm(c_s, affine=true, bias=false)
    linear_s_gamma = Linear(c_s, c_a, bias=true)
    sigmoid = x -> 1.0 ./ (1.0 .+ exp.(-x))
    linear_s_beta = Linear(c_s, c_a, bias=false)
    return AdaLN(layer_norm_a, layer_norm_s, linear_s_gamma, sigmoid, linear_s_beta)
end

function forward(adaln::AdaLN, a, s)
    a = adaln.layer_norm_a(a)
    s = adaln.layer_norm_s(s)
    a = a .* adaln.sigmoid(adaln.linear_s_gamma(s)) .+ adaln.linear_s_beta(s)
    return a
end

mutable struct BiasAttention
    c_v::Int
    c_hidden::Int
    no_heads::Int
    linear_v
    linear_o
    linear_g
    sigmoid
end

function BiasAttention(c_v, c_hidden, no_heads)
    linear_v = Linear(c_v, c_hidden * no_heads, bias=false)
    linear_o = Linear(c_hidden * no_heads, c_v, bias=false)
    linear_g = Linear(c_v, c_hidden * no_heads, bias=false)
    sigmoid = x -> 1.0 ./ (1.0 .+ exp.(-x))
    return BiasAttention(c_v, c_hidden, no_heads, linear_v, linear_o, linear_g, sigmoid)
end

function _prep_v(ba::BiasAttention, v_x)
    v = ba.linear_v(v_x)
    v = reshape(v, size(v)[1:end-1]..., ba.no_heads, :)
    v = permutedims(v, [1:ndims(v)-3; ndims(v)-1; ndims(v)-2; ndims(v)])
    return v
end

function _wrap_up(ba::BiasAttention, o, x)
    g = ba.sigmoid(ba.linear_g(x))
    g = reshape(g, size(g)[1:end-1]..., ba.no_heads, :)
    o = o .* g
    o = reshape(o, size(o)[1:end-2]..., :)
    o = ba.linear_o(o)
    return o
end

function _attention(ba::BiasAttention, v, biases)
    a = sum(bias for bias in biases)
    a = softmax(a, dims=length(size(a)))
    o = batched_mul(a, v)
    return o
end

function forward(ba::BiasAttention, x, biases=nothing, use_deepspeed_evo_attention=false)
    v = _prep_v(ba, x)
    o = _attention(ba, v, biases)
    o = _wrap_up(ba, o, x)
    return o
end

function pad_to_max(data, value=0)
    if typeof(data[1]) <: String
        return data, 0
    end
    if all(size(d) == size(data[1]) for d in data)
        return cat(data..., dims=1), 0
    end
    num_dims = length(size(data[1]))
    max_dims = [maximum(size(d, i) for d in data) for i in 1:num_dims]
    pad_lengths = []
    for d in data
        dims = []
        for i in 1:num_dims
            push!(dims, 0)
            push!(dims, max_dims[num_dims-i+1] - size(d, num_dims-i+1))
        end
        push!(pad_lengths, dims)
    end
    padding = [pad(ones(size(d)), pad_len, value=0) for (d, pad_len) in zip(data, pad_lengths)]
    data = [pad(d, pad_len, value=value) for (d, pad_len) in zip(data, pad_lengths)]
    padding = cat(padding..., dims=1)
    data = cat(data..., dims=1)
    return data, padding
end
